about: The languages page, /language/ (web/build.mjs), lists every language in assets/locales/<id>/meta.json. "next" holds the languages new in the next pre-release, in development: they are listed even before their files are bundled (with the data given here; a meta.json wins) and marked as coming in the next pre-release. Empty it once that release ships. "nextVersion" is the version that ships them, named on the page and in its welcome ("from 0.8.8.9 it ships 35 languages"): keep it after that release, or reword the welcome. The welcome's number of countries and the visits chart come from visits-by-country.json.
